verdict.rationale: Calendly ships AI features (Notetaker recordings and transcripts, the Callie assistant, an MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps user data out of AI model training. The OAuth scopes and authentication docs cover API access control, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
